about: SVM-DT on two builds of the Top-1-gram profiles, against the paper. 3-iteration: PSI-BLAST 3 iterations, E = 0.001 (the lab's Pse-in-One 2.0 settings), Top-1-gram = largest weighted observed percentage (top1.py). 2008 method: the paper's ref. [28] (Liu et al. 2008): PSI-BLAST defaults with 10 iterations, rows under 98% identity, Henikoff weights, BLOSUM62 pseudocounts with beta = 10 (profile2008.py). Both against the lab's 2016 nrdb90 with BLAST+ 2.17.0, same Gist port, seed 1 and clip rule. The 2008-method profiles are the pipeline's SVM-DT input.
reading: The 2008-method profiles bring the family-level SVM-DT results to the paper: family 2.5.1.3's ROC (0.993 against the paper's 0.993), its Fig. 4A heatmap (Spearman 0.875 against 0.770, (L,L) second as published) and its Fig. 5A-B bars (r 0.58 and 0.50 against 0.39 and 0.28), though the bar heights still do not come back (10% of bar ends within 2 px, against 13% and 11%). The 54-family means move the other way: about 0.01 ROC above the paper at every dMAX (0.957 against 0.948 at 150), and the cut-list ROC50 0.838 against 0.800. So the profile method was part of the difference, and what remains sits in the means: our 2016 nrdb90 and BLAST+ 2.17.0 are not the paper's (it names only 'a non-redundant database', and the copy the lab used is not available), which is untested.
